summary: iter413bp — Admin Operations Dashboard landing layer tested end-to-end. Backend aggregator contract passes 8/8 (test_iter413bp_ops_dashboard.py). Frontend: dashboard loads at /admin/dashboard in ~2.9s, all six sections render with correct data-testids, Operations sidebar pill works as virtual landing layer, deep-link CTAs navigate to admin tabs, returning via Operations pill re-mounts the dashboard cleanly, contrast linter passes, no purple/violet in Aged Canvas tokens.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the dismiss button did not hide the brief in a re-tested run (testid was visible & clicked; brief still rendered after 500ms). May be a stale-closure / state issue in the dismiss handler, or a cookie banner z-index intercept. First run did dismiss correctly — appears intermittent.

action_items: OPTIONAL spec mismatch: spec lists testids 'ops-brief-dismiss' and 'ops-funnel-open-full', but component implements them as 'ops-daily-brief-dismiss' and 'ops-founder-funnel-open'. Functionally correct. Either update spec or rename in OperationsDashboard.jsx (lines 195, 328) to match the contract in the review request.

Investigate intermittent daily-brief dismiss: re-verify the !dismissed gate and ensure the onClick handler is stable; possibly cookie banner overlay intercepted the click. Add force={true}-equivalent z-index or move brief above the cookie z-stack if reproducible.
critical_code_review_comments: ops_dashboard.py uses synchronous-looking awaits inside an inline ternary like `... if 'orders' in await db.list_collection_names() else 0` — readable but `list_collection_names()` is called 5+ times per request; consider caching the set at the top of the endpoint to reduce round trips.
_section_recent_activity over-fetches (8+8+5+5+5 = 31 docs) and trims to 20 in memory. Acceptable but could push limit=20 and merge-sort by ts.

Founder funnel uses 7d window for stages 2-6 but visitors=analytics_events page_view in same 7d — already sensible. Conversion_pct will mislead when visitors is 0; currently returns 0.0 which is fine.
OperationsDashboard.jsx Aged Canvas tokens look clean (ink / paper / line / brand) — no Tailwind purple/violet detected.
